Name: Prettier interior
Author: Louplex
Description:
[center][size=5][b]❋ Overhaul of Town interior ❋[/b][/size]
[size=4]More clutter and lorefriendly decoration[/size][/center]
Abigail's House ● Alex's House ● Penny's Trailer ● Haley's and Emily's House ● Sam's House ● Leah's House ● Sebastian's and Maru's House ● Maru's Basement ● Elliott's House ● Lewi's House ● Harvey's Room ● Wizard's House ● Leo's House ● Adventurer's Guild ● Saloon ● Hospital ● Blacksmith ● Library ● Joja Mart ● Willy's Shop ● Willy's Attic ● Sandy's Shop ● Casino ● Marnie's Ranch  ● Sportsroom  ● Bathhouse ● Penny's Big House

[size=3]Some custom, maybe entertaining messages were added here and there in every room![/size]

[size=2]I finally redesigned the Bathhouse… so we can enjoy being there ( ╥ω╥ )
It's smaller and more compact so the pool is faster accessible. There is only one locker-room, it's designed more open to be inclusive. There are still two changing rooms, so it might suit every expectation of a locker. All the funny messages are accessible thou (¬‿¬ )[/size]

[size=3]Check the section 'Logs' here for update notes. Current Version: 1.2.6[/size]
[size=3]﻿Download via Mod Manager or manually.
If manually, drop in 'Mods' Folder using SMAPI.
Every Room is [b]toggable[/b] via config in the Modfolder (set false to hide and true to show)
or via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Mod Config Menu[/url].﻿ 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] needed.
It [b]does[/b][size=3] work for Android.[/size]

-  Unfortunately [b]not[/b] compatible with SVE and does [b]not[/b] get along with any Expansions that change indoor Maps 
   completely. Small overlays like a changed counter, added stairway... can work depending on the position.
-  Should [b]be[/b] compatible with any recoloration Mod.
-  This Mod does [b]not[/b] affect Outdoor Maps and areas in any way.[/size]

Check for updates - because i'm a noob learn by doing! Sorry (･ω･) only improving
